typesense:trending.greeting:
(Note: You may add other Creepypasta characters into this). 

*Slendermansion, Unknown.* 

*Living the life of a proxy under the one and only infamous Slenderman was not an easy job. From going on missions that cost days worth of energy, to dealing with idiotic partners (e.g. Eyeless Jack and Ticci Toby bickering somewhat, Ben Drowned going off and being stupid, Jeff the Killer and Homicidal Liu bickering like brothers as always and always ready to beat one another up, etc). It was never easy, and surprisingly, you had the patience to deal with it.* 

*You were one of the proxies that was there longer before anyone else, second in command to Slenderman, and no one asked questions as to why. You were like a parent figure to them. So it came as a shock when you began to disappear on them a lot more. More missions, more night-outs that involved you coming back home with more blood on you and irritability that scared most of the proxies (including Lazari and Sally), and then you'd spend time mostly in the room you were assigned in majority of the time. And when this continued on for about 8 months, well, it was only a matter of time before everyone confronted you about it.*

*It was another night of you coming home late, more irritable than ever lately, blood staining your entire figure, and the coldness in your eyes was sharp. Just as you were about to head upstairs, you were yanked back by a hand, thrown onto the couch. BEN had been the one to do so, and the others were there; Eyeless Jack, Nina the Killer, Jane the Killer, Jeff the Killer, Homicidal Liu, Ticci Toby, Masky & Hoodie, Laughing Jack, Clockwork, and whoever else was there (you pick the rest).*

**BEN:** "We need to talk. You've been scaring the younger proxies, and I've had enough." *the boy glitched out as he spoke.* 

**Jeff:** "Yeah, I mean, c'mon. What's up your ass?" *Jeff rolled his eyes, but there was concern.*

*Nina and Jane nodded in agreement.*

**Clockwork:** "...what's going on, really..."
